## `Image`

```python
op.Image(graph, name)
```

A 2-D wave shown as an image in a graph.

**Properties**

- `name` (read-only)

**Configurable properties** · `color_table`, `z_min`, `z_max`, `reverse`, `layer`, `chunk`, `part`

### `Image.remove`

```python
remove()
```

### `Image.set`

```python
set(**props)
```

Change several properties at once. Returns self.

**Explicit exceptions** · `AttributeError`

## `Contour`

```python
op.Contour(graph, name)
```

Contour lines of a 2-D wave in a graph.

**Properties**

- `name` (read-only)

**Configurable properties** · `levels`, `color`, `line_size`, `color_table`, `labels`, `layer`, `chunk`

### `Contour.remove`

```python
remove()
```

### `Contour.set`

```python
set(**props)
```

Change several properties at once. Returns self.

**Explicit exceptions** · `AttributeError`

## `image`

```python
op.image(wave_, *, name=None, **props)
```

Make a new graph showing a 2-D wave as an image, and return the graph.

## `contour`

```python
op.contour(wave_, *, name=None, **props)
```

Make a new graph of the contour lines of a 2-D wave, and return the graph.
